name: Neon cloud database platform landing page by neon.tech
description: A high-contrast infrastructure landing page uses near-black surfaces, oversized white typography, muted gray supporting copy, and electric green accents to create a technical but editorial tone. The page moves from a dense hero with navigation, abstract database imagery, capability tiles, and customer logos into spacious feature demonstrations; pale mint interludes reset the rhythm before returning to black sections for branching, authentication, enterprise features, proof points, a final CTA, and a compact multi-column footer.
